Keyword research guide

Start with seeds

Pick two to five seed terms that describe what you sell. Not what you wish you sold, and not the category name a consultant gave you, but the words a customer would actually type into a search box when they have the problem you fix.

Expand with autocomplete

Autocomplete is free and it is ordered by real popularity, which makes it the single most useful free signal available to a small team. Query it with many different prefixes rather than one.

Score and prioritise

Volume alone is a trap. Multiply demand by commercial intent by winnability, and work the top of that list.
